title: Computational Design

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Connect letter deformation to controllable variables because viewers need a coherent relationship between a changing form and its behavior.
strategic_value: A recognizable serif A that stretches and skews can connect classical letterforms with contemporary performance.
demonstration: A chart at left accompanies a serif A at right; the A grows vertically, skews across the field and returns.
practical_value: Compare the effects of vertical stretch and skew before combining them in a responsive wordmark.
